title: Nova Shop
wikitext:
{{Rebirth|image1=Nova Shop Main.png|status=In-game|title1=Nova Shop}}

The '''Nova Shop''' is a shop found in the [[Super Rebirth|SRB]] area of the cantina. In the Nova Shop players can purchase Nova Shop upgrades with Nova Crystals.

== Location ==
[[File:Location SRB.jpg|thumb|Location of the Nova Shop.]]
The Nova Shop can be found behind the cantina. It's opposite of the Super Rebirth shop and it's operated by a [[RIC-1200]]. 

== Nova Shop Upgrade Cost ==
These are all Nova Shop upgrades with more coming in future updates. Most upgrades have multiple stages that requires more Nova Crystals. Some upgrades have no limit or can be purchased with V-Bucks in a pack at the Cantina Shop. Note that you '''can't refund any purchases'''. Down here is a table that shows the prices of all SRB upgrades and their cost. 

'''''If you are unable to see some levels on the tabels down below, press the expand button on the top left side of your screen.'''''
